# haoxue-public

Example sentences used as the tutor's curriculum.

- Source: https://github.com/haoxue-tutor/haoxue-public
- Commit: `3c12c3291d19180faf163b72082fb719a796a365`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

The file names say HSK 1–4. The sentences are model-written examples grouped by a target word or pattern. They are not the official HSK word lists.
